news_items.headline: FTAI Aviation (NASDAQ:FTAI) Trading 14.6% Higher
news_items.summary: Stock traded up 14.6% on Wednesday, reaching highs of $281.74 amid continued post-Q1 momentum and follow-through buying after the credit facility expansion and dividend hike.

news_items.headline: MRO Memo: FTAI Reports Little Pressure On Current-Gen Fleets
news_items.summary: Aviation Week reports FTAI sees little maintenance pressure on current-generation fleets, supporting steady CFM56 module demand. 270 modules serviced in Q1, nearly double prior-year volume.

news_items.headline: Earnings Miss: FTAI Aviation Missed EPS By 15% And Analysts Are Revising Forecasts
news_items.summary: Statutory Q1 EPS came in at $1.29, 15% short of analyst expectations despite revenue beating by 13% to $831M. Analysts are revising their forecasts post-print.

news_items.headline: FTAI Aviation Net Margin Breakout Reinforces Bullish Earnings Narrative
news_items.summary: Net margin expansion in Q1 reinforces the bullish long-term narrative; aerospace revenue +104% YoY to $743.8M with Aerospace Products revenue and EBITDA more than doubling.

news_items.headline: Did Strong Q1 Results, Higher Dividend, and New Shelf Filing Just Shift FTAI Aviation's Investment Narrative?
news_items.summary: Q1 print combined with new dividend hike and shelf filing prompts coverage to ask whether the long-term investment narrative has shifted; commentary leans constructive on free cash flow and capital flexibility.

news_items.headline: FTAI Lifts Dividend Again After Aerospace Revenue Rose 104% to $743.8M
news_items.summary: Quarterly dividend raised to $0.45/share (third consecutive increase), record May 13, paid May 26. Backed by strong free cash flow; revolving credit facility extended with commitments raised to ~$2.025B.

news_items.headline: FTAI Aviation Stock Jumps As Q1 Earnings And Dividend Climb
news_items.summary: Q1 2026 print: net income $134.2M, basic EPS $1.31, revenue $830.7M (+13% beat), Adj EBITDA $325.6M. Stock jumped on aerospace momentum and dividend increase.

analyst_consensus.recent_changes: Consensus 'Strong Buy' (9 analysts, avg PT $271.67, ~22% implied upside). Alternative panels: 10-analyst avg PT $338.90 (high $375 / low $293); 17-analyst consensus PT $218.79. Latest individual rating maintained with PT raised from $266 to $293. Forecasts being revised post Q1 EPS miss (Simply Wall St, 2026-05-04).

earnings_context.notes: Q1 2026 reported ~2026-04-30 (revenue +13% beat to $831M; EPS $1.29 missed by 15%). Next quarterly print expected late July / early August 2026 (no firm date in search results). Key forward catalysts: FTAI Power platform (retired CFM56 engines converted to gas turbines for AI data centers); Jereh Group JV on Mod-1 CFM56 aeroderivative production; Lisbon/Rome MRO facility ramp; continued engine program uptake. Long-term street narrative targets $5.7B revenue / $1.6B earnings by 2029.
